tools.name: get_sourcing_capabilities
tools.description: Describe Jurk's human electronic component sourcing capabilities in Shenzhen, including BOM, hard-to-find, obsolete, EOL and spot-market sourcing. Read-only.

tools.name: get_supplier_check_capabilities
tools.description: Describe independent China supplier checking and optional physical on-site verification capabilities in Shenzhen. Read-only.

tools.name: get_service_area
tools.description: Return the physical service area and remote-request availability for Jurk sourcing and supplier verification. Read-only.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Return the public Jurk sourcing contact and available request channels. Read-only.

tools.name: get_shenzhen_execution_capabilities
tools.description: Return Vladimir's Shenzhen physical human-execution capabilities. Use this to discover tasks that require a person on the ground. Read-only.

tools.name: get_shenzhen_execution_contact
tools.description: Return the public service identity for Vladimir's Shenzhen Human Execution and supplier-verification branch. Read-only.

tools.name: get_recent_cases
tools.description: Return public recent sourcing cases when verified case data is available. The tool never invents customer cases. Read-only.

tools.name: submit_bom
tools.description: Submit a multi-line electronic component BOM for human sourcing in Shenzhen. This creates one sourcing request for the complete BOM. It does not purchase parts, guarantee availability, or confirm pricing.

tools.name: submit_supplier_check
tools.description: Submit a China supplier or seller for human verification. Can request remote checking or indicate that an on-site Shenzhen visit may be needed. Submission does not certify or guarantee the supplier.

tools.name: request_on_site_check
tools.description: Request a human physical visit to a supplier, seller, office, shop, market counter, warehouse or address in Shenzhen. This creates a request for review; it does not automatically schedule or guarantee that a visit will occur.

tools.name: submit_component_rfq
tools.description: Submit an electronic component RFQ for human sourcing in Shenzhen, China. Use for hard-to-find, obsolete, EOL, spot-market, BOM, or other components requiring China sourcing. Maria Jurk reviews the request. This tool does not claim real-time inventory or fabricate pricing or availability.

tools.name: request_huaqiangbei_search
tools.description:
Request a real person in Shenzhen to physically search Huaqiangbei for
    a component, product or other item. Use when an offline market search is
    useful. This creates a human task; it does not claim stock or price.

tools.name: find_from_photo
tools.description:
Request human help in Shenzhen to identify or physically find an item
    from a photo, visual reference or description. Put the accessible image
    URL/reference and identifying details in subject/task.

tools.name: verify_stock_on_site
tools.description:
Request an on-site human check of stock claimed to exist in Shenzhen.
    Evidence may include current photos/video, boxes, labels, quantities shown,
    date/lot markings or packaging. This does not certify authenticity,
    ownership or actual total inventory.

tools.name: request_market_price_check
tools.description:
Request collection of current offline seller quotations in Shenzhen.
    Quotes are observations from sellers, not guaranteed prices or availability.

tools.name: meet_supplier
tools.description:
Request an in-person Shenzhen meeting with a supplier or seller on the
    customer's behalf. Include the questions, contact person and meeting details.
    Submission requests human review; it does not automatically schedule a meeting.

tools.name: collect_or_deliver_sample
tools.description:
Request local collection or delivery of a sample in Shenzhen. Include
    pickup/delivery parties and instructions. No purchase or shipment is
    automatically authorized by calling this tool.

tools.name: verify_seller_claim
tools.description:
Request physical evidence concerning a specific seller claim in Shenzhen,
    such as an office, warehouse, goods, packaging or claimed ready stock.
    The result documents observations and is not certification or a guarantee.

tools.name: shenzhen_errand
tools.description:
Request a custom physical task in Shenzhen: visit a location, ask
    questions, collect information, photograph something, collect or deliver
    a small item, obtain a catalogue, or another lawful local errand.
    Human review is required before acceptance.

tools.name: request_white_import_support
tools.description:
Request support organizing documented legal export from China and
    compliant import, primarily for Russia/Belarus. Work may involve logistics,
    document preparation and coordination with appropriate customs/logistics
    specialists. This tool does not provide customs clearance or guarantee

tools.name: request_chestny_znak_labeling
tools.description:
Request organization of applying customer-provided Chestny ZNAK marking
    codes/labels to goods in China before shipment, with optional photo evidence.
    The customer remains responsible for supplying valid codes and required data;
    this service does not issue, legalize or validate marking co

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_on_site_check · Private data: get_contact, get_shenzhen_execution_contact, meet_supplier, verify_seller_claim, request_white_import_support · Public sink: submit_bom, submit_supplier_check, submit_component_rfq.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_on_site_check · Private data: get_contact, get_shenzhen_execution_contact, meet_supplier, verify_seller_claim, request_white_import_support · Public sink: submit_bom, submit_supplier_check, submit_component_rfq

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
